fields.label: Traccar Server URL
fields.description: The address you open Traccar on, e.g. https://gps.hipersignerp.cloud

fields.label: Traccar API Token
fields.description: In Traccar: Settings → Account (your user) → Token → generate and copy here. Use an admin user so every device is visible.

fields.label: Check In / Check Out & GPS Alarm
Track Only Between Check In and Check Out
fields.description: Phones start tracking (and the GPS-off alarm) when the worker checks in from the app, and stop when they check out. Check-ins are saved as Employee Checkin with the location.

fields.label: Require Location to Check In / Out
GPS-off Alarm Repeat (seconds)
fields.description: While a checked-in worker's GPS is off, the phone rings again every this many seconds (minimum 10).

fields.label: Notify Head After (repeat alarms)
fields.description: 1 = notify the head on the 2nd alarm (after one repeat). 0 = notify straight away.

fields.label: Phone App
fields.description: Phones send their locations straight to this ERP (no Traccar server needed).

fields.label: Phone Report URL
fields.description: Where the HiperTracker phone app sends locations (Traccar's device port, usually 5055). Put into the phone by the setup QR on each device.

fields.label: App Download Link
fields.description: Shown as the 'Install app' QR on each device.

fields.label: Create Devices in Traccar Automatically
fields.description: Saving a device here adds it to Traccar (or renames it) with the same identifier.

fields.label: Map Zoom
fields.description: 8 shows all of Kerala

fields.label: Mark Offline After (minutes)
fields.description: A phone with no update for this long is shown as offline, even if Traccar still says online.

fields.label: Show Unassigned Traccar Devices on Map
fields.description: System Managers also see Traccar devices not yet linked to a person.

fields.label: Keep Location History (days)
fields.description: Older locations are deleted every night.

fields.label: Alert head when a checked-in phone stops reporting
fields.description: Sent after 'Offline After (minutes)' with no location (phone off, no internet or app stopped).

fields.label: Repeat Alerts Every (minutes)
fields.description: While the problem continues, the head is reminded at most this often.

fields.label: Add new phones automatically
fields.description: A phone that sends a location with an ID ERP doesn't know yet is added to Devices & People as 'Phone <ID>'. Open it and set the Employee.

fields.label: Require device key
fields.description: Off: phones only need the server address (e.g. https://nexus365.hipersignerp.cloud) and their ID, like Traccar. On: only phones set up by ERP login or setup QR (which carry the device's key) are accepted.

fields.label: Stop After (minutes)
fields.description: Staying within about 150 m for this long counts as a stop (or idle time). The movement between two stops is a trip.

fields.label: Speed Limit (km/h)
fields.description: Going faster than this is recorded as over-speeding. A device can have its own limit (e.g. lower for trucks). 0 = off.

fields.label: Alert head when someone goes over the limit
Petrol price per litre
fields.description: Used to work out the fuel cost of a trip plan

fields.label: Default vehicle mileage (km per litre)
fields.description: Used when a phone's own vehicle mileage is not set

fields.label: Expense type for trip petrol
fields.description: Used when a worker claims the petrol of a trip from the app

fields.label: Diesel price per litre
fields.description: For vehicles whose Fuel Type is Diesel (others use the petrol price)

fields.label: Routing Server (OSRM)
fields.description: Road routes for the app's trip screen. Empty = the free public OSRM server (fine for a small team; for heavy use run your own OSRM and put its address here).
